description: This file is a script that analyzes source code files to enforce extension plugin SDK boundary rules. It imports various utilities for file system operations, path manipulations, TypeScript AST parsing, and project-specific path classifications. The script collects, parses, and inspects source files to identify import/export patterns that violate established boundary rules, and provides CLI commands to output inventory, compare against expected baseline, and report violations.

methods.name: isCodeFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename corresponds to a code file based on its extension.

methods.name: collectExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects source code files from the project directory, excluding test and dist directories.

methods.name: collectParsedExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Reads and parses all collected source files into TypeScript ASTs.

methods.name: resolveExtensionRoot
methods.description: Determines the extension root segment from a file path.

methods.name: classifyReason
methods.description: Generates a human-readable reason string for an import/source code violation based on mode and import details.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting inventory entries.

methods.name: shouldReport
methods.description: Determines if an import should be reported based on mode and resolved path.

methods.name: collectEntriesByModeFromSourceFile
methods.description: Extracts import/export entries from a source file, classifying them according to mode.

methods.name: collectExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Builds an inventory of boundary violations for a specific mode by analyzing source files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads baseline inventory JSON for a given mode.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventories to identify discrepancies.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory report as a human-readable string.

methods.name: runExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the boundary check process, outputs results in JSON or human-readable format, and handles exit codes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the script, manages process exit code.
